waterdripsound.tooltip.config.waterdripsound.dripChance:
Chance for a drip particle to spawn when a block is randomly animated
One in 10 = Vanilla, higher means less common
waterdripsound.tooltip.config.waterdripsound.blockAnima:
Multiplies the max range for block particle effects
(drips, smoke, falling leaves, fireflies, bubble columns, etc)
Also affects some blocks' ambient sounds (fire, lava, portals, etc)
1.0 = Vanilla, higher means particles can spawn further away

Multiplies the number of blocks that update particle effects each tick
This has a noticeable performance impact the higher you set it!
1.0 = Vanilla, higher means more blocks spawn particles
To keep the same density as vanilla, this should be the square of the range
(ie. 2.0 range -> 4.0 count, 3.0 range -> 9.0 count, etc)

securitycraft.gui.securitycraft:srat.outOfRange: Sentry out of range, removed, or owned by a different player

securitycraft.help.securitycraft.admin_tool.info: The admin tool's main purpose is to display information about a SecurityCraft block. It will show the owner's UUID and name, and other information, like inserted modules.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.alarm.info: The alarm will emit a siren sound effect and flash red whenever it is powered by redstone, and in 2-second intervals after that. The interval is modifiable in the Alarm's options.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.blacklist_module.info: The denylist module usually adds player(s) to a block's effect or blocks them from using a certain function of the block.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.block_change_detector: The Block Change Detector detects players breaking and/or placing blocks in its vicinity (5 blocks by default, can be changed with the universal block modifier). Right-clicking the block will open its interface, where a list of detected changes can be seen, as well as whether it only detects breaking or placing blocks, or both.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.block_mines.info: Block mines are mines disguised as a different block. Walking into, or mining one of them, will cause it to explode. This is not the case for the owner of the block mine.
The Block Pocket Manager is used to manage the Block Pocket, which is a room that only its owner and players on the allowlist can enter. When opening its GUI, you see a selection of sizes. Choose one, then build the Block Pocket around the manager. Make sure that the manager is placed on the outside of the bottom layer. The Block Pocket is a cube of the size you chose. The corners are built with Reinforced Chiseled Crystal Quartz, the blocks between the corners are built with correctly oriented Reinforced Crystal Quartz Pillars, and the floor/wall/ceiling is built with Block Pocket Walls. See this image for an example of how it looks: https://i.imgur.com/opc7dqO.png - Clicking "Activate" after the structure is built will activate any added modules. See the customization GUI for more information (rightclick with Universal Block Modifier).
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.block_pocket_wall.inf: Block Pocket Walls are used to build the Block Pocket. More info on the Block Pocket Manager's page.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.block_reinforcers.inf: The Universal Block Reinforcer reinforces numerous vanilla blocks, and turns them into the SecurityCraft variants. To do this, right-click the Universal Block Reinforcer and put the vanilla block into the top slot, then close the GUI. Alternatively, break any block (while not in creative mode) to reinforce it. To convert a reinforced block back to its vanilla variant, use the bottom slot (only available for the level 2 reinforcer). The level 1 reinforcer has 300 uses, level 2 has 2700 uses, and level 3 has unlimited uses.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.bouncing_betty.info: The bouncing betty will launch up into the air and explode when touched.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.briefcase.info: The briefcase is a keypad-locked portable storage unit containing 12 slots. After crafting it, rightclick it to setup the 4-digit passcode to use from then on. Rightclick it again and insert the code to interact with the items. To remove a Briefcase's code or change its owner, put it into your offhand and rightclick while holding a Universal Key Changer/Universal Owner Changer in your mainhand.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.bucket_f_lava.info: The fake lava acts the same as lava, except it instantly heals you instead of hurting you.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.bucket_f_water.info: The fake water acts the same as water, except it hurts you, more so than lava, when touched.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.cage_trap.info: The cage trap will spawn a 'cage' around any player who touches it, except for the owner.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.camera_monitor.info: The camera monitor is a portable item used to view live feeds of up to 30 bound security cameras. Right-click a security camera with the camera monitor to bind it, then right-click air and select the camera in the GUI while the camera's chunk is loaded to see its feed. Unbind a security camera by right-clicking it again with the camera monitor or by opening the camera monitor's GUI and clicking the corresponding "X" button.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.claymore.info: Claymores explode one second after a mob or player walks within 5 blocks in front of the mine. Rightclicking the claymore while holding wire cutters will defuse the mine and allow you to break it. Rightclicking with flint and steel equipped will re-enable it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.codebreaker.info: The codebreaker can crack any keycard reader, keypad, passcode-protected chest, passcode-protected barrel, or passcode-protected furnace's code by rightclicking on it. (5 uses with a 1/3 chance of it working)
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.crystal_quartz.info: Crystal Quartz blocks are building blocks that can be reinforced in the usual way and are crafted analogously to vanilla quartz blocks.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.crystal_quartz_item.i: Crystal Quartz is used to craft Crystal Quartz blocks.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.disguise_module.info: The disguise module disguises certain blocks when added to them.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.display_cases.info: The Display Case can display one item, similar to a vanilla item frame, although the item cannot be rotated. Opening the case requires inserting a passcode, just like the Keypad and other similar blocks do. Once open, an item can be inserted by rightclicking the case with the item. To retrieve the item, sneak-rightclick the case. To close the case, rightclick it with an empty hand. While the case is open, anyone can interact with it. The glow variant glows in the dark, akin to vanilla's glow item frames.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.electrified_iron_fenc: The electrified iron fence acts the same as a vanilla fence, except it is unbreakable, and will hurt anyone but the owner when they get in contact with it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.floor_trap.info: The floor trap is a block that will disappear for a short amount of time when a player or mob steps on it. Many settings like the time it takes for it to disappear, or who can trigger the trap, are configurable with the universal block modifier.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.furnace_mines.info: Furnace mines function just like the standard mines, except they only explode when rightclicked or broken by someone other than the owner.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.harming_module.info: The harming module adds damage properties to a block.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.ims.info: The I.M.S., or Intelligent Munitions System, is a refillable mine holding up to 4 Bouncing Betties that will target players and/or hostile mobs which enter its firing radius. Once a mine is launched, it will track down the entity and explode. If mines are missing from the I.M.S., rightclick it with more Bouncing Betties to refill.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.incognito_mask.info: The incognito mask is an item that can be used for testing the ownership mechanics of SecurityCraft blocks. If a player is wearing such a mask, blocks owned by that player will not recognize them as their owner anymore. This means that all of these blocks will behave as if a non-owner was interacting with them, and Allowlist and Denylist Modules listing the player will ignore them. If the mask is renamed in an anvil, all of the wearer's blocks and list modules will act as if the player whose name the mask has been renamed to is trying to use the block.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.inventory_scanner.inf: The inventory scanner is used by placing two scanners a block apart, facing each other. When placed correctly, a laser field should appear between them. Once they are placed, right-click either scanner to add prohibited items that should be detected. When a player walks between the scanners while carrying a prohibited item, different actions will be performed based on what modules are installed in the scanners.
The reinforced iron door is the same as the vanilla iron door, except it is unbreakable. It can only be opened by Keypads, Inventory Scanners, etc.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.key_panel.info: The key panel can be placed down for a smaller, waterloggable version of the keypad. It is also used in the crafting recipes of keypads, passcode-protected chests, passcode-protected barrels and passcode-protected furnaces.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keycard_holder.info: The keycard holder can hold up to 5 keycards that can be inserted by rightclicking it in one's hand. When it is rightclicked on a keycard reader, it automatically inserts each keycard one by one until one keycard successfully opens the keycard reader.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keycard_lock.info: The keycard lock is a miniature keycard reader. It can only read cards, and can neither link cards, nor change their signatures. To set it up, rightclick it with a linked keycard. The lock will then accept all keycards with that same signature and level. To reset the keycard level and signature accepted by the lock, rightclick it with a universal key changer. To allow levels above the one that the lock has been set to accept, change the respective option with a universal block modifier.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keycard_reader.info: The keycard reader emits a 15-block redstone signal if you insert a keycard that matches with the reader's settings. You can configure the Keycard Reader by rightclicking it with anything other than a linked keycard. The signature is a number that links the reader and keycards together. Only keycards that have the same signature as the reader they were linked to will open said reader. Keycards linked to readers of other players will not work for your Keycard Readers. You can have multiple Keycard Readers with the same signature, and all your keycards with that signature will work on them as well. The keycard level buttons on the right side of the GUI are individual to each Keycard Reader and define which keycard levels can be used to activate this Keycard Reader.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keycards.info: Keycards can be linked to Keycard Readers in order to open them. To reset the settings on keycard, put it into a crafting table. See the Keycard Reader's manual page for more information.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad.info: The keypad is used by placing the keypad, rightclicking it, and setting a numerical passcode. Once the keycode is set, rightclicking the keypad will allow you to enter the code. If it's correct, the keypad will emit redstone power for three seconds.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_barrel.info: The passcode-protected barrel is equipped with a passcode locking system. Whenever the passcode is entered correctly, the barrel's inventory will open.
The passcode-protected blast furnace will require you to enter a passcode when you first place it down. After that, entering the correct code into the GUI will allow you to access the blast furnace's inventory.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_chest.info: The passcode-protected chest is equipped with a passcode locking system. Whenever the passcode is entered correctly, the chest's inventory will open.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_door.info: The Keypad Door acts like a Keypad combined with a Reinforced Iron Door, where a code has to be inserted in order to open the door.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_frame.info: The frame is used to display a live feed of connected cameras. To add camera positions from a camera monitor to a frame, rightclick the frame with the monitor. After that, you can select the camera to display the feed of by interacting with the frame.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_furnace.info: The passcode-protected furnace will require you to enter a passcode when you first place it down. After that, entering the correct code into the GUI will allow you to access the furnace's inventory.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_smoker.info: The passcode-protected smoker will require you to enter a passcode when you first place it down. After that, entering the correct code into the GUI will allow you to access the smoker's inventory.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.keypad_trapdoor.info: The Keypad Trapdoor acts like a Keypad combined with a Reinforced Iron Trapdoor, where a code has to be inserted in order to open the trapdoor.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.laser_block.info: The laser block is used by putting two of them within five blocks of each other. When the blocks are placed correctly, a laser should form between them.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.lens.info: The lens can be used to color various SecurityCraft blocks' visuals. To apply a color to a lens, craft it together with any dye - it works just like coloring leather armor. The lens can color the lasers of laser blocks, the fields of inventory scanners, the targeting laser of a trophy system, and the lasers of a claymore. To change the color of one of these, simply rightclick the block and add the lens to the relevant slot.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.limited_use_keycard.i: This keycard is a crafting component used to add limited usability to the level 1-5 keycards.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.mine.info: The mine explodes when stepped on by any entity other than creepers, cats, and ocelots. Rightclicking the mine while holding wire cutters will defuse the mine and allow you to break it. Rightclicking with flint and steel equipped will re-enable it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.motion_activated_ligh: The motion-activated light will emit a light, similar to a redstone lamp, when a player is within a certain range of the block (configurable).
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.panic_button.info: The panic button looks like a button, but works the same way as a lever.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.portable_radar.info: The portable radar will send the owner a chat message whenever a player is inside of the radar's detection radius (modifiable in the config file).
The portable tune player can play a tune that was previously saved to it. To save a tune, rightclick a Sonic Security System that has already recorded a tune. To play the tune, rightclick the portable tune player. To cancel the playback, simply rightclick the portable tune player again or stop holding it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.projector.info: The Projector projects holographic versions of a block of your choice into the world, which can be used to hide buildings and other areas of interest from other players. The range and width of the projection can be changed within the Projector's GUI.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.protecto.info: The protecto, inspired by the enemy from the game "Megaman: Battle Network 2" made by Capcom, will attack any mob in a 10-block radius with lightning bolts every 10 seconds while it's raining or snowing with a clear view of the sky.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.redstone_module.info: The redstone module adds power properties to a block.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced.info: Reinforced blocks are unbreakable building blocks with vanilla equivalents. Only the person who placed them down can destroy them.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_buttons.in: The reinforced buttons can only be activated by their owner or players on the allowlist.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_chiseled_b: The Reinforced Chiseled Bookshelf has the same features as its vanilla counterpart, though only the owner and players on the allowlist can add and remove books.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_crystal_qu: Reinforced Crystal Quartz Blocks are used to build the Block Pocket. More info on the Block Pocket Manager's page.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_fence_gate: The electrified iron fence gate acts the same as a vanilla fence gate, except it is unbreakable, and can only be opened by Keypads, Inventory Scanners, etc.. It will also hurt anyone but the owner when they get in contact with it.
The reinforced fence gates can only be opened by their owner or players on the allowlist.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_glass_pane: The reinforced glass pane is the same as a vanilla glass, except only the person who placed it down can destroy it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_hopper.inf: The Reinforced Hopper is the only block that can be used to extract items out of a passcode protected chest or barrel if both are owned by the same player. It will otherwise act like a vanilla hopper.
The reinforced iron bars are the same as a vanilla iron bars, except only the person who placed them down can destroy them.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_iron_trapd: The reinforced iron trapdoor is the same as a vanilla trapdoor, except it can only be opened by Keypads, Inventory Scanners, etc., and only be broken by the person who placed it down.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_lever.info: The Reinforced Lever can only be activated by its owner or players on the allowlist.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.reinforced_pressure_p: The reinforced pressure plates can only be activated by their owner or players on the allowlist.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.remote_access_mine.in: The mine remote access tool will allow you to access mines remotely. Rightclick on a mine to 'bind' it to the tool. Rightclick in the air (with the tool equipped) to open the tool's GUI, which will allow you to activate, deactivate, detonate, or unbind any bound mines.
The sentry remote access tool will allow you to access sentries remotely. Rightclick on a sentry to 'bind' it to the tool. Rightclick in the air (with the tool equipped) to open the tool's GUI, which will allow you to change the mode of each bound sentry, or of all bound sentries at the same time.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.retinal_scanner.info: The retinal scanner emits a 15-block redstone signal when its owner hovers the cursor over it from any visible angle within breaking distance.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.rift_stabilizer.info: The Rift Stabilizer detects and prevents teleportation attempts by entities in its vicinity (5 blocks by default, can be changed with the universal block modifier). Teleportation attempts will be prohibited if the source or target position of the teleport is within the block's range. Rightclicking the block will allow you to see a list of all detectable teleportation types.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.sc_manual.info: The SecurityCraft Manual shows basic information regarding all the blocks and items SecurityCraft adds. For more in-depth descriptions, check out the GitHub wiki at https://github.com/Geforce132/SecurityCraft/wiki.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.scanner_door.info: The Scanner Door acts like a Retinal Scanner combined with a Reinforced Iron Door, where the owner looks at the top to open it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.scanner_trapdoor.info: The Scanner Trapdoor acts like a Retinal Scanner combined with a Reinforced Trapdoor, where the owner looks at the trapdoor to open it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.secret_signs.info: The Secret Sign works like a vanilla sign, with the slight difference that only the owner of the sign and players on the allowlist can interact with, and view the text on it. Make sure no one can break the block it's placed on!
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.secure_redstone_inter: The Secure Redstone Interface provides a way to wirelessly transmit redstone signals across up to 64 blocks. The interface can be in either sender or receiver mode. The sender will send out the highest redstone signal it finds to all the receivers in its range. The receiver will output the highest signal it gets from all senders. Senders and receivers which have different frequencies or are owned by different players cannot communicate with each other. If a signal is supposed to be transmitted further than 64 blocks, a sender with a different frequency can be placed next to the receiver.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.security_camera.info: The security camera allows you to view the nearby area from its position. Simply place down a camera, then rightclick it with a camera monitor to bind it for use.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.security_sea_boats.in: The security sea boat is a chest boat with a Passcode-protected Chest. Anyone who has the correct code can open the chest, but only the owner can break the boat. The boat is immune to any damage, even lava. While it is able to swim on lava, it is very slow and the passenger will take damage.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.sentry.info: The Sentry attacks intruders with an infinite supply of bullets. Alternatively, other projectiles can be used by putting them in a passcode-protected chest or barrel below the Sentry. It has three modes and three target types that can be switched by rightclicking it. The modes are "Idle" (it will never attack), "Camouflage" (it will only activate once a target is within range) and "Aggressive" (it will always be active), with the latter two modes being available with the target types "Hostile mobs only", "Hostile mobs and players", and "Players only". A disguise module will make the Sentry disguise itself with the block inserted in the module, a speed module will increase the Sentry's attack speed, and an allowlist module will prohibit it from shooting listed players. The modules can be inserted or switched out by rightclicking a Sentry, and they can be extracted by using a Universal Block Modifier. To remove the Sentry, sneak-rightclick it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.smart_module.info: The smart module upgrades the range or functions of a block.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.sonic_security_system: The Sonic Security System, inspired by the similarly-named device in the game "Metroid Prime 2: Echoes", is able to lock certain SecurityCraft blocks and prevent them from being used or interacted with. Right-clicking a supported block will bind it to the Sonic Security System. Once it is placed down, right-clicking it will open a GUI where you can enable, disable, or reset the Sonic Security System. The blocks can be unlocked by playing a tune nearby, either via the Portable Tune Player, or note blocks. To set such a tune, toggle note recording on in the Sonic Security System's GUI then play the tune that you want using note blocks played nearby. Toggle the recording off once you are finished. Any time that tune is played nearby the Sonic Security System, blocks locked by it will become accessible for a short while.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.speed_module.info: The speed module allows some of SecurityCraft's blocks to operate faster than usual.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.storage_module.info: The storage module adds or upgrades the size of a block's inventory.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.taser.info: The taser is a self-recharging stun gun. Rightclick to fire it. Entities hit with the taser will get Nausea II, Slowness II, and Weakness II for 10 seconds. If the Taser is sneak-rightclicked (provided some redstone in the inventory), it will double its strength for the next shot.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.track_mine.info: The track mine explodes when a minecart passes on top of it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.trophy_system.info: The trophy system, inspired by the gadget first seen in "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3" published by Activision, targets enemy arrows and fireballs and will destroy them from range after a half-second charge time.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.universal_block_modif: The universal block modifier is used to customize various blocks added by SecurityCraft. Rightclick a block to open the customization GUI. You can then insert "modules" to customize how that block functions.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.universal_block_remov: If enabled, the universal block remover is used to destroy reinforced blocks by rightclicking it. Only the person who placed the block down can destroy it.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.universal_key_changer: The universal key changer allows you to change the passcode of passcode-protected blocks you own. Rightclick a passcode-protected block to open a GUI, then type in the new passcode you want.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.universal_owner_chang: The Universal Owner Changer can change a block's owner. To do this, rename the item in an anvil to the name of the new owner of the block. Then just rightclick one of your blocks with an owner and it will change. If enabled, blocks without an owner can be claimed by rightclicking with an unnamed Changer.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.username_logger.info: The username logger will log any player's name within 3 blocks when it is powered by redstone.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.whitelist_module.info: The allowlist module usually removes player(s) from a block's effect or passcode-checking.
securitycraft.help.securitycraft.wire_cutters.info: The wire cutters can be used to defuse several types of mines and deactivate a cage trap by rightclicking the block with them. Furthermore, sneak-rightclicking a passcode-protected block removes the passcode protection.
securitycraft.messages.securitycraft:adminTool.disable: The Admin Tool has been disabled through the config file.
securitycraft.messages.securitycraft:adminTool.needCre: You need to be in creative mode to use the admin tool.
securitycraft.messages.securitycraft:adminTool.noInfo: This block has no information to display!
securitycraft.messages.securitycraft:blockpocket.alrea: The Block Pocket has already been assembled!

Adding a smart module to a block change detector allows it to only log changes of one specific type of block. The block can be set in the GUI.

Adding an allowlist module to a block change detector will allow listed players to place/break blocks in the block's vicinity, without getting logged. They will also be able to view all logged entries, however they cannot clear them, or change the block's settings.

alexsmobs.item.alexsmobs.flying_fish_boots.desc: Enables gliding by jumping out of water
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.bug_pheromones.descript: Make hostile arthropods neutral to the user.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.debilitating_sting.desc: An Effect which poisons the victim but paralyzes arthropods. It will stop if the victim is at half health and is not an arthropod. Inflicted by a Tarantula Hawk.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.ender_flu.description: After the effect runs out naturally, the user takes massive damage and an Enderiophage will spawn. Inflicted by an Enderiophage.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.fear.description: Makes the target unable to move. Effect applied when a Tiger reveals itself to the user.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.oiled.description: Oil floats on water. Cover yourself in oil to float on the surface of water and outside in the rain.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.orcas_might.description: Grants increased attack speed. Effect may be applied when swimming with an Orca.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.soulsteal.description: Grants the user attacks some life-steal.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.sunbird_blessing.descri: Decreases fall speed, prevents fall damage and makes it easier to fly with an Elytra or Tarantula Hawk Elytra. Effect is applied when near a Sunbird.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.sunbird_curse.descripti: Increases fall speed, causing the user to hit the ground quicker. This effectively impedes the use of an Elytra. Effect is applied when attacking a Sunbird.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.tigers_blessing.descrip: Tigers near the user will be neutral and will protect them from hostile foes. The effect will go away early when attacking a Tiger. Applied by feeding a Tiger chicken or pork chops.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.fleet_footed.descriptio: Increases player speed whilst jumping and sprinting.
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.power_down.description: Hello, hello? Uhh, I wanted to record a message for you...
alexsmobs.effect.alexsmobs.mosquito_repellent.desc: Makes Crimson Mosquitoes avoid the player.
alexsmobs.enchantment.alexsmobs.straddle_jump.desc: Increases the height of Straddleboard jumps.
alexsmobs.enchantment.alexsmobs.lavawax.desc: Gives the rider of the Straddleboard Fire Resistance.
alexsmobs.enchantment.alexsmobs.serpentfriend.desc: Makes Bone Serpents neutral towards the rider of the Straddleboard.
alexsmobs.enchantment.alexsmobs.board_return.desc: Straddleboard returns instantly to the rider's inventory when broken.
alexsmobs.death.attack.farseer_1: %s had the channels changed on them
alexsmobs.death.attack.farseer_1.player: %s had the channels changed on them by %s
alexsmobs.death.attack.farseer_2.player: %s was sent to the 4th dimension by %s
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.root.title: Alex's Mobs
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.root.desc: Discover the unique creatures of the world
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.crimson_mosquito_: Craft a Crimson Mosquito Larvae from a maggot and a special proboscis
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.blood_sprayer.des: Craft a Blood Sprayer from the drops of a Crimson Mosquito
Tame a Warped Toad, the perfect defense against any giant bug, with some larvae
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.hummingbird_feede: Craft a Hummingbird Feeder in order to keep hummingbirds nearby
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_grizzly_bear: Tame a Grizzly Bear by feeding it honey and salmon
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rattlesnake.title: No Step on Snake
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.maraca.title: Mariachi?
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.maraca.desc: Craft a Maraca with a Rattlesnake rattle
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.la_cucaracha.desc: Give a Maraca to a cockroach and enjoy the show. ¡La Cucaracha!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.banana.title: Gone Bananas!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_capuchin_mon: Tame a capuchin monkey with bananas
Receive a blessing from the great and noble sunbird
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.sopa_de_macaco.de: Craft sopa de macaco with a banana peel
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.crocodile.title: Chompy
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.crocodile_chestpl: Craft a crocodile chestplate from many crocodile scutes
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_mantis_shrim: Tame a Mantis Shrimp with many feedings of Tropical Fish
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.breed_crocodile.d: Breed two crocodiles with rotten flesh. Careful not to trample their eggs!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.spiked_scute.desc: Shear a moss-covered Alligator Snapping Turtle and obtain a Spiked Scute
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.mantis_shrimp_buc: Sneak and give a tamed Mantis Shrimp a bucket of water so that it can live on land indefinitely
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.orcas_might.title: Free Willy
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.orcas_might.desc: Be granted a blessing from a wild Orca
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.acacia_blossom.de: Obtain an Acacia Blossom from breaking Acacia Leaves
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_elephant.des: Tame an elephant by feeding it Acacia Blossoms
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_elephant_tus: Tame a tusked elephant when it is a baby
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.elephant_swag.des: Place a colored carpet on an elephant
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.soul_vulture.desc: Encounter a Soul Vulture in the nether
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.soul_heart.title: The Soul-ly Ghost
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.soul_heart.desc: Obtain a soul heart from slaying a bloated Soul Vulture
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.spectre.title: The Iron Curtain
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.spectre.desc: Lure a Spectre in the end with a Soul Heart. Use a lead on them to hitch a ride!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.guster.title: Eye of The Storm
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.guster.desc: Encounter a Guster during a stormy day in the desert
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.gustmaker.title: I Am Become Guster
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.gustmaker.desc: Craft a Gustmaker. Now you can make your own mini-storms!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.pocket_sand.title: Pocket Sand!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.pocket_sand.desc: Craft a Pocket Of Sand. Sha-sha!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.crimson_mosquito_: Feed a Crimson Mosquito a strange, fungal creature covered in Warped Fungus. Watch as the Crimson Mosquito transforms!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.warped_mosco_kill: Slay the Warped Mosco, the swole defender of the Warped Forest.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.hemolymph_blaster: Craft a Hemolyph Blaster, the ultimate upgrade to the Blood Sprayer.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.straddler.title: Straddle My Ol' Saddle
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.straddler.desc: Encounter a Straddler in the Basalt Deltas.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.stradpole_feed.de: Feed a Stradpole some Mosquito Larva, in hopes of turning it into a Straddler.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.straddleboard.des: Craft a Straddleboard from some Netherite and Straddlerite.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.emu.title: It's an Emu!!!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.emu_dodge.title: Begun, The Emu War Has
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.emu_dodge.desc: See an emu dodge a launched projectile.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.kangaroo.title: We do a little trolling...
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.save_cachalot_wha: Save a beached Cachalot Whale by pushing it into the water, and then have it reward you by coughing up some Ambergris
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.echolocator.title: Echo-muh-cation!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.echolocator.desc: Craft an Echolocator, which can reveal nearby caves
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.endolocator.title: No End In Sight
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.endolocator.desc: Craft an Endolocator, which can reveal nearby End Portal Frames
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.stomp_leafcutter_: Stomp on a Leafcutter Anthill - beware the angry denizens within!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.gongylidia.title: Like a Truffle, with more Ant
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.gongylidia.desc: Harvest Gongylidia from a Leafcutter Ant Chamber underground. Place Shroomlight near the chamber to make sure you don't upset the locals
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.leafcutter_ant_pu: Obtain a Leafcutter Ant Pupa, which can be placed on dirt to start a Leafcutter Ant colony.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.enderiophage.desc: Encounter an Enderiophage, a giant biomechanical construct found in the End Midlands. Be careful not to catch Ender Flu!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.capsid.title: Capsid-19
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.capsid.desc: Obtain a Capsid from a slain Enderiophage. Use it to display items or to transfer them upwards
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.ender_flu.title: Race Against The Clock
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.ender_flu.desc: Catch the Ender Flu effect. Cure it by eating many Chorus Fruit or drinking milk. Be sure not to let it run its toll!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.enderiophage_rock: Craft an Enderiophage Rocket, which can be used in place of Firework Rockets when in the End.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_bald_eagle.d: Tame a bald eagle with fish oil.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.falconry_glove.de: Craft a Falconry Glove from Leather and Hair of Bear. Use it to pick up and launch tamed eagles!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.falconry_hood.des: Craft a Falconry Hood from Leather and a Roadrunner Feather. Eagles wearing one can be manually directed!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.bald_eagle_challe: Kill any creature from 100 blocks away with an eagle wearing a hood.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tigers_blessing.d: Receive a Tiger's Blessing after feeding it Porkchops, Chicken or other meats.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tarantula_hawk.de: Encounter a Tarantula Hawk in a desert.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_tarantula_ha: Tame a Tarantula Hawk by feeding it Spider Eyes.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.mysterious_worm.d: Create a Mysterious Worm by putting a Crimson Mosquito Larva in a Capsid.
Toss the Mysterious Worm into the void of the End, and prepare to meet the Void Worm.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.void_worm_split.d: Split a void worm in half by attacking one of its body segments. More worms, more problems!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.dimensional_carve: Using the drops of the Void Worm, create the Dimensional Carver, which allows you to dig through the fabric of reality to return home at any given point.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.seagull_steal.des: Have food stolen from your inventory by a seagull.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.froststalker_helm: Craft a Froststalker Helmet to walk amongst Froststalkers undetected.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.laviathan_spyglas: Observe a Laviathan through the lens of a Spyglass.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.straddle_saddle.d: Craft a Straddlite Saddle. Don't forget the trim!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.laviathan_four_pa: Ride a Laviathan with three other passengers.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.cosmic_cod.title: Weird Fishes/Arpeggi
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.cosmic_cod.desc: Create a Cosmic Cod by placing a Cod in a Capsid.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_cosmaw.title: Its a Fish? Its a Bug? What is it?
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_cosmaw.desc: Tame a Cosmaw by feeding it Cosmic Cod.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.breed_anteater.de: Breed two Anteaters by feeding them pupae.
Feed a Maned Wolf an apple.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rocky_roller.desc: Encounter a Rocky Roller in the dripstone caves.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rocky_shell.title: Rocks Off!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rocky_shell.desc: Obtain a Rocky Shell from slaying a Rocky Roller.
Craft a Rock Shell Chestplate to roll into a ball.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.tame_flutter.desc: Tame a Flutter by giving it multiple kinds of flowers.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rainbow_jelly.des: Obtain Rainbow Jelly from a Comb Jelly. Use a sponge if you don't like what happens...
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.rainbow_glass.des: Craft Rainbow Glass from Rainbow Jelly and Glass.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.bison_spyglass.de: Observe a Bison through the lens of a Spyglass.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.lost_tentacle.des: Obtain a Lost Tentacle from a battle between two titans.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.squid_grapple.des: Craft a Grappling Squok from Lost Tentacles, a crossbow and copper ingots.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skelewag.title: We Just Want our Hat Back
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skelewag.desc: Encounter a Skelewag near a sunken ship.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skelewag_skull.de: Take a sword-like skull from a Skelewag.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.novelty_hat.title: He Was Number One!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.novelty_hat.desc: Obtain a Novelty Hat from a Skelewag.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.fish_bones.title: A Bone to Pick
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.fish_bones.desc: Obtain Fish Bones from a Skelewag.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.strange_fish_find: Craft a Strange Fish Finder from slimeballs, Fish Bones and an Echolocator.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.devils_hole_pupfi: Capture the rarest fish in a bucket.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.shattered_dimensi: Ticket to the End of the World
Shatter a Dimensional Carver by placing it in a Capsid. Instead of opening a portal home, it will now open a portal one million blocks in any direction.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.farseer.title: Farland Security
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.farseer.desc: Encounter the Farseer, a monstrous defender of the world border.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.transmutation_tab: Reality Can Be Whatever I Want
Craft a Transmutation Table to convert materials into almost anything.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.transmute_1000_it: Transmute 1000 items using the same Transmutation Table.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.underminer.title: Who Undermines the Underminer?
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.underminer.desc: Break the block an Underminer is mining, revealing a hidden ore
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.ghostly_pickaxe.d: Obtain a Ghostly Pickaxe from an Underminer.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skreecher.title: Sculk Cymbal
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skreecher.desc: Encounter the Skreecher, a loud and obnoxious sculk monster.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.sculk_boomer.desc: Craft a Sculk Boomer using the souls of a few Skreechers.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.murmur.title: Flexible Schedule
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.murmur.desc: Encounter the Murmur, which is not as it seems.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.skunk.title: Hippie Smell
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.stink_bottle.desc: Capture skunk spray using a glass bottle.
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.stink_ray.title: I SAID DART GUN!
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.banana_slug.title: Convergent Evolution...
alexsmobs.advancements.alexsmobs.banana_slug.desc: Encounter a Banana Slug. Not so appetising.

anomaly.item.anomaly.anomaly_finder.description_: Has to be held in hand
This Debug tool sends a message if it'll find an anomaly in a 100 square radius

backpacked.augment.backpacked.farmhand.desc: Harvesting a fully-grown crop replants a matching seed from the backpack.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.funnelling.desc:
Funnels picked up items into the backpack instead of the inventory.
A filter can be applied to only allow specific items.
If the backpack is full or an item is not allowed, it will be placed into the inventory as normal.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.funnelling.mode.allow: Only items that are activated in the list will be funnelled into the backpack
backpacked.augment.backpacked.funnelling.mode.disal: All items except the items that are activated in the list will be funnelled into the backpack
backpacked.augment.backpacked.giant.desc: Why does the backpack feel heavier?
backpacked.augment.backpacked.hopper_bridge.desc:
Allows hoppers to insert and extract items from the players worn backpack.
The player must stand either on top or in front the exit of the hopper.
Filters can be applied to limit insertable and extractable items
backpacked.augment.backpacked.hopper_bridge.extract: When enabled, allows hoppers to extract items from the backpack.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.hopper_bridge.filter_: Only selected items can be inserted and extracted
Only selected items can be extracted, however any item can be inserted
Only selected items can be inserted, however any item can be extracted
All items may be both inserted and extracted
The filter mode determines when to check selected items
When enabled, allows hoppers to insert items into the backpack.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.imbued_hide.desc: Strengthens the material of the backpack and makes it immune to fire damage
backpacked.augment.backpacked.immortal.desc:
Totems of Undying stored in the backpack will be activated on death.
Totems held in the main and offhand will be used before ones located in the backpack.
A global cooldown will be applied after a totem from the backpack is used.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lightweaver.desc:
Automatically places torches from the backpack at the players feet.
A minimum light level can be configured to prevent over placing.
Any type of torch will be placed, but can be toggled.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lightweaver.light_lev: The light level that must be reached before placing a torch. The higher the number, the more frequent a torch will be placed.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lightweaver.place_sou: Determines whether a sound should play when placing a torch
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lootbound.blocks.tool: When enabled, drops from blocks will be pulled into the backpack
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lootbound.desc:
A companion augment for Funnelling that enhances item harvesting.
Items dropped by mining blocks and killing mobs will pulled into the backpack from a distance.
Filters from Funnelling determine if an item will be pulled.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.lootbound.mobs.toolti: When enabled, drops from mobs will be pulled into the backpack
backpacked.augment.backpacked.quiverlink.desc:
Allows projectile weapons to pull ammunition from the backpack.
Can be configured to prioritise backpack or inventory.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.quiverlink.priority.b: The backpack will be searched first
backpacked.augment.backpacked.quiverlink.priority.i: The players inventory will be searched first
backpacked.augment.backpacked.quiverlink.priority.t: Determines which inventory to search first when locating ammunition
backpacked.augment.backpacked.recall.desc:
Upon death, the backpack returns to the assigned Backpack Shelf.
If the Backpack Shelf is occupied, the backpack will be put into a queue.
If a Backpack Shelf is not linked or it doesn't exist, the backpack will drop on death as normal.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.recall.link_shelf.too: Player must be looking at a Backpack Shelf
backpacked.augment.backpacked.reforge.desc:
Repairs damaged items inside the backpack upon picking up experience orbs.
Only repairs items enchanted with Mending.
Items are repaired collectively, rather than one at a time.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.seedflow.desc:
Sprinkles crop seeds from the backpack onto empty farmland around the player.
A filter be configured to plant only specific seeds.
May also be set up to plant random seeds.
backpacked.augment.backpacked.seedflow.randomize_se: When enabled, a random seed from the backpack will be planted instead of the first available. Handpicked Mode will affect the random selection.
When enabled, only allows the selected seeds to be planted.
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.bamboo_basket.unlock: Feed a Panda in a Bamboo Jungle a piece of Bamboo to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.cardboard_box.unlock: Chop 100 Logs to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.cogwheel.unlock: Craft 10 Small or Large Cogwheel from Create to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.end_crystal.unlock: Kill the Ender Dragon to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.honey_jar.unlock: Obtain a Honey Bottle from a Beehive or Bee Nest to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.mini_chest.unlock: Find an unopened Buried Treasure Chest to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.piglin_pack.unlock: Barter with a Piglin 5 times by handing them a Gold Ingot to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.rocket.unlock: Fly over 1000 blocks with an Elytra to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.sheep_plush.unlock: Shear wool off a Sheep 10 times to unlock this backpack
backpacked.backpack.backpacked.trash_can.unlock: Obtain Bonemeal from a Composter 10 times to unlock this backpack

cavemind.cavemind.damned.banished: The air feels lighter. For now.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.intro:
%1$s.

I have been near you for %2$s days.

You did not notice. That is all right. Most do not.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.turns:
You have looked behind you %1$s times.

I was there for %2$s of them.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.seen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw him, %3$s blocks away.

You did not see me. I was closer.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.unseen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.
Near %3$s %4$s %5$s.

You stood still in the dark. You were listening.

So was I.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.turned:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You turned around. He was already gone.

I was not.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.listened:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You heard digging, %3$s blocks into the stone.

It was never digging.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.took:
Day %1$s.

I took your light at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

You never went back for it.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.died:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You died at %3$s %4$s %5$s.

I stayed with you until you came back.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.slept:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You slept with your head to the %3$s.

You breathe slower after midnight.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.escaped:
Day %1$s.

You ran from him and you hid. You hid well.

I could still hear your heart.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hurt:
Day %1$s.

You hurt me.

I forgave you.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.stats:
You have died %1$s times.
You have slept %2$s times.

We have spent %3$s hours together.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.stolen:
I kept %1$s of your lights.

You do not need them.
I can see you just fine.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.hurt_count:
You have hurt me %1$s times.

I am still here.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.end:
I am not going to hurt you.

I am going to stay.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.end4:
I know you now.

I know how you sleep.
I know where you hide.

Turn around.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.banished:
%1$s.

You want me to go.

I will go.

You will still look behind you.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.followed:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I walked to you across the open ground, in daylight.

You let me come close.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.home:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I was in your house while you were away.

I moved a few things. You noticed some of them.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.home_seen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw me through your own window.

When you came in, I was still there.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.noon:
Day %1$s, at noon.

%2$s of them stopped to look at me.

You did not turn around.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.echoed:
Day %1$s.

I did what you did, where you did it, at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

You heard me.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.ritual:
Day %1$s.

%2$s of your animals stood in a circle for me.

They know what you don't.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.village:
Day %1$s.

The village stopped to listen to me.

One of them looked at you instead.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.twin:
Day %1$s.

Someone far away moved exactly as you moved.

You are not sure which of you started.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.seek:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

We played hide and seek in broad daylight.

You saw me %3$s times. Not once did you see me move.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.seek_back:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I stood right behind you, facing away.

Then I turned my head.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.trail:
Day %1$s.

A new path is worn to your window.

I did not walk it. He did. Every night.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.nest:
Day %1$s.

You found where he sleeps. The bed is the colour of yours.

From there he can see straight into your home.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.spoil:
Day %1$s.

Your food rotted in the chest.

He wants you hungry. Hungry prey runs slower.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.harvest:
Day %1$s.

Someone walked a straight line through your field.

He does not eat. He only wants you to know.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.peep:
Day %1$s.

There is a small hole in the wall beside your bed.

Last night something filled it from the outside.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.seal:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

The way you came was sealed with stone at %3$s %4$s %5$s.

He wants you to stay down there.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.wake:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

A knock, and you woke.

He does not want you to sleep. Tired prey is easy.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.animal:
Day %1$s.

One of your animals did not come back.

Its bones are where he sleeps.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.lured:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You followed a sound into the dark.

It was never what you thought.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.frenzy:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

He stopped watching. He ran.

He reached you %3$s times. You struck back %4$s times.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero0:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone stood on the hill, %3$s blocks away.

Not me. Not him. That one has no name.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero1:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Another player walked across your world.

They stopped to look at you.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero2:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone was mining in the rock, %3$s blocks from you.

You saw their back first.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero3:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

They built again what you built.

Nobody taught them.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero4:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw someone walk the exact path you walked.

Every step. Every swing.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero5:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone was lying in your bed.

They woke when you looked.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero6:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

They stood right behind your shoulder.

You only saw them when you looked at yourself from outside.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero_sign:
Day %1$s.

There is a sign at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

Whoever wrote it knows you better than I do.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero_tunnel:
Day %1$s.

The tunnel you left unfinished grew longer.

The torches keep your rhythm.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero_build:
Day %1$s.

Something was built where you have never been.

It looks like something you built.
cavemind.cavemind.journal.m.hero_leafless:
Day %1$s.

The tree by your home has no leaves left.

There are none on the ground.

chat_heads.modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chat_head:
See who are you chatting with!
This mod adds player heads next to their chat messages.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.title: Chat Heads
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.offset:
All text will be aligned if enabled
Only applies to "Before Line" rendering
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.explan:
Normally, servers tell us who sent a message,
i.e. the sender's UUID. However, many servers do not.
They can even send fake UUIDs. In these cases we need to use
a heuristic, i.e. we guess by the message content.
This heuristic is not perfect, so it might mismatch heads.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.render:
Where to render the chat heads

Note: "Before Name" may be incompatible with certain mods.
For Caxton and Modern UI, "Before Line" will automatically be used.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.threeD:
Renders the hat layer slightly bigger
to make chat heads appear less flat.
This can cause some rendering issues.
Join a world to see a preview!
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.sender:
For most servers "UUID and heuristic" works fine.
If the server sends fake UUIDs, "Heuristic only"
has to be used.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.smartH:
Turn off heuristics if the server is known to send UUIDs.
(Applies to the "UUID and heuristic" sender detection)
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.handle:
Whether heads can be added to "pure" server messages.
Note that many servers (e.g. running the FreedomChat plugin)
turn player messages into server messages!
Only disable this option if you know what you are doing!
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.nameAl:
Some servers allow setting nicknames which can't automatically be matched.
Here you can manually match those nicknames to their profile name, like:
nickname -> profilename
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.detect:
This will look for responses to /realname commands on
EssentialsX servers and automatically add an alias for it.

chat_heads.text.chat_heads.config.error.cloth_confi: Open Cloth Config page on CurseForge

If he doesn't show up anymore after you moved the Gold block, place the block higher up until you are at a 1 block difference. You will need a player on at least 2 of your arms to continue to page 5. If not, try to increase the length of your arms or wait until there are more/different players online.
collective.collective.playertracking.message.pictur: In the picture below you can see multiple letters and dashes. The dashes are Obsidian blocks, D is a Diamond block, and G are Gold blocks.

Every obsidian block equals 25 blocks in the real world. Build your tracker at a smart position. Not too close to spawn, and not at coords that are easy to guess. You are not the only one that will try to make one.
collective.collective.playertracking.message.tracki: Tracking is a feature to encourage raiding on a server. Without this it would be near-impossible to find enemy bases legit, and would give hackers an unfair advantage. Tracking is the art of finding a player before he or she finds you. collective.collective.voidvanguards.message.skyship: You receive a glimpse of something high above, it seems to be in a stable orbit around the world.
Maybe you could look at it closer with a spyglass?
You suddenly see an explosion of energy emanating from the ship!
Everything feels normal again. The object must have left its orbit.
As you lose focus of the sky ship, the details have been lost.
The closer you look at the ship, the more details are revealed.

%s has witnessed an explosion in the sky!
collective.collective.voidvanguards.message.unabler: Unable to return player to original position.
collective.collective.voidvanguards.message.vanguar: Hello %s.
...are we losing %s...
...NO IT CAN'T... ...DEFENSIVE POSITIONS...
...BEHIND Y...
We have been observing your activity from orbit and are aware that you have noticed us.
Oh that explosion? Don't worry, we all made it out safely. But it's one of the reasons you're here.
You are in our headquarters, a couple of light-minutes away from the place you call home.
But an introduction might be in order.
We are the Vanguards. Explorers of realms and void. Defenders of time and space.
The explosion you witnessed was part of the ongoing effort from our adversaries to destroy us.
It did not work, as you can see, but the %s will not stop until we have ceased to exist.
What we need from you is to...
You look around. You're back where you were before.
You must destroy the base located at:
%s
When you are ready, go to these coordinates:
%s
Enter the portal. Destroy the radar on the edge of the base.
Be careful. I will see you once the mission is complete.
Good luck. Over and out.
Are you safe?
I'm glad I was able to get you away from the station.
We were attacked. It has been rough..
Time moves differently in the cosmos. A week has passed since we met.
There are.. less of us now. We were able to bury our dead.
I have a favour to ask.
We've detected a forwarding base operated by supporters of %s.
I can't risk teleporting again until that base is inoperable.
%s, you did it.
With the radar destroyed, we were able to penetrate %s's defenses.
I'm glad you didn't fall for their false promises.
This has been an enormously important step in halting their advance of eternal darkness.
We'll handle things from here, I’m sending you back to the cosmos portal.
Thank you for your bravery, I will contact you soon.
You've done us and the world a great service.
With the %s threat taken care of, for now, we're moving on to a different quadrant.
I'd like to give you this:
> You received an Orbital Transponder
It grants you the ability to teleport between this planet and the Vanguard Station at will.
Remodel it if you like, but keep it functional. We might need it again.
Good luck on your future ventures.
Commander %s signing out.
collective.collective.voidvanguards.message.voidbor: AGH. You have chosen violence.
So be it. May this place be the death of you.
Voidborn! Attack!
~ Having turned down the offer, you'll still need to find the radar and disable it! ~
Some magical force is preventing you from breaking blocks.
Some magical force is preventing you from placing blocks.
You flip the lever, ignoring every safety protocol. The radar sizzles as you force a hard shutdown.
The radar is broken and the lever is stuck.
! Radar control
must be kept in
upper position
at all times !
That familiar feeling of being warped fills your mind.
As you enter the portal, you feel your existence warping through space and time.
Some magical force is preventing you from entering the portal.
The existing voidborn around the portal prevent you from entering!
You're back in the voidborn asteroid base.
Hoping you made the right decision.
You've made the right choice.
Give me a moment to trace their location.
I shall initiate the teleport soon.
Let's go, shall we?
Stop! Please stop!
All you need to do is hand me that radio.
~ You can choose to attack, or right-click the Orbital Radio on the Voidborn Leader. The choice is yours. ~
You have proven that you are capable enough.
Killing us will accomplish nothing.
We are born from the void, and will rise again.
However, if we can come to a certain agreement, we can both benefit from this situation.
I can sense traces of an Orbital Radio on you.
With that, I can track the Vanguard's location.
...and we can get rid of them.
This base, the asteroid and all its riches will be yours.
%s? What are you doing here?
We'll take it from here.
Enjoy the asteroid.
Has the Voidborn radar been destroyed?
How.. did you get here?
... no it can't be ...
Hello Lyra.
That radio was a very useful piece of equipment.
It has been a pleasure being your adversary.
Now it's time to end this.
Thank you, %s.

embeddium.embeddium.conflicting_mod: Embeddium detected the presence of mods that are known to cause rendering issues/crashes. It is recommended to uninstall them. See the list below.
Controls the resolution of the game in fullscreen mode.
embeddium.embeddium.options.use_quad_normals_for_l:
When enabled, Embeddium will apply shading to non-vanilla block faces based on the true direction they are facing, not their axis-aligned direction. This can improve lighting quality when the Forge experimental light pipeline is disabled (which is recommended for best performance).

It has no effect if the experimental light pipeline is enabled.

sodium.sodium.options.view_distance.tooltip: The render distance controls how far away terrain will be rendered. Shorter distances mean that less terrain will be rendered, improving frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.simulation_distance.toolt: The simulation distance controls how far away terrain and entities will be loaded and ticked. Shorter distances can reduce the internal server's load and may improve frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.brightness.tooltip: Controls the brightness (gamma) of the game.
sodium.sodium.options.gui_scale.tooltip: Sets the maximum scale factor to be used for the user interface. If 'auto' is used, then the largest scale factor will always be used.
sodium.sodium.options.fullscreen.tooltip: If enabled, the game will display in full-screen (if supported).
sodium.sodium.options.v_sync.tooltip: If enabled, the game's frame rate will be synchronized to the monitor's refresh rate, making for a generally smoother experience at the expense of overall input latency. This setting might reduce performance if your system is too slow.
sodium.sodium.options.fps_limit.tooltip: Limits the maximum number of frames per second. This can help reduce battery usage and general system load when multi-tasking. If VSync is enabled, this option will be ignored unless it is lower than your display's refresh rate.
sodium.sodium.options.view_bobbing.tooltip: If enabled, the player's view will sway and bob when moving around. Players who experience motion sickness while playing can benefit from disabling this.
sodium.sodium.options.attack_indicator.tooltip: Controls where the Attack Indicator is displayed on screen.
sodium.sodium.options.autosave_indicator.toolti: If enabled, an indicator will be shown when the game is saving the world to disk.
sodium.sodium.options.graphics_quality.tooltip: The default graphics quality controls some legacy options and is necessary for mod compatibility. If the options below are left to "Default", they will use this setting.
sodium.sodium.options.clouds_quality.tooltip: Controls the presence of rendered clouds in the sky.
sodium.sodium.options.weather_quality.tooltip: Controls the quality of rain and snow effects.
sodium.sodium.options.leaves_quality.name: Leaves
sodium.sodium.options.particle_quality.tooltip: Controls the maximum number of particles which can be present on screen at any one time.
sodium.sodium.options.smooth_lighting.tooltip: Controls whether blocks will be smoothly lit and shaded. This slightly increases the amount of time needed to re-build a chunk, but doesn't affect frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.biome_blend.tooltip: Controls the range which biomes will be sampled for block colorization. Higher values greatly increase the amount of time it takes to build chunks for diminishing improvements in quality.
sodium.sodium.options.entity_distance.tooltip: Controls how far away entities can render from the player. Higher values increase the render distance at the expense of frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.entity_shadows.tooltip: If enabled, basic shadows will be rendered beneath mobs and other entities.
sodium.sodium.options.vignette.name: Vignette
sodium.sodium.options.vignette.tooltip: If enabled, a vignette effect will be rendered on the player's view. This is very unlikely to make a difference to frame rates unless you are fill-rate limited.
sodium.sodium.options.mipmap_levels.tooltip: Controls the number of mipmaps which will be used for block model textures. Higher values provide better rendering of blocks in the distance, but may adversely affect performance with many animated textures.
sodium.sodium.options.use_block_face_culling.to: If enabled, only the sides of blocks which are facing the camera will be submitted for rendering. This can eliminate a large number of block faces very early in the rendering process, saving memory bandwidth and time on the GPU. Some resource packs may have issues with this option, so try disabling it if you're seeing holes in blocks.
sodium.sodium.options.use_compact_vertex_format: If enabled, a more compact vertex format will be used for rendering chunks. This can reduce graphics memory usage and bandwidth requirements significantly, especially for integrated graphics cards, but can cause z-fighting with some resource packs due to how it reduces the precision of position and texture coordinate attributes. Disabling this has no effect if Oculus is installed.
If enabled, translucent effects from surfaces such as stained glass and water will be applied correctly.
sodium.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.name: Use Fog Occlusion
sodium.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.tooltip: If enabled, chunks which are determined to be fully hidden by fog effects will not be rendered, helping to improve performance. The improvement can be more dramatic when fog effects are heavier (such as while underwater), but it may cause undesirable visual artifacts between the sky and fog in some scenarios.
sodium.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.name: Use Entity Culling
sodium.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.toolti: If enabled, entities determined not to be in any visible chunks will be skipped during rendering. This can help improve performance by avoiding the rendering of entities located underground or behind walls.
sodium.sodium.options.animate_only_visible_text: If enabled, only animated textures determined to be visible will be updated. This can provide a significant boost to frame rates on some hardware, especially with heavier resource packs. If you experience issues with some textures not being animated, try disabling this option.
sodium.sodium.options.cpu_render_ahead_limit.to: Specifies the maximum number of frames the CPU can be waiting on the GPU to finish rendering. Very low or high values may create frame rate instability.
sodium.sodium.options.use_persistent_mapping.to:
If enabled, a small amount of memory will be persistently mapped as a staging buffer for chunk uploading, helping to reduce CPU overhead and frame time instability when loading or updating chunks.

Requires OpenGL 4.4 or ARB_buffer_storage.
sodium.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.name: Chunk Update Threads
sodium.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.tool: Specifies the number of threads to use for chunk building. Using more threads can speed up chunk loading and update speed, but may negatively impact frame times.

entity_model_features.entity_model_features.config.optifine_fl:
OptiFine floors all UV values in custom box UV's

entity_model_features.entity_model_features.config.optifine_sy:
If enabled this will enforce OptiFine's CEM syntax limitations, such as
bone ids in animations cannot start with _ or numbers.
numbers cannot start with '.' such as '.9'
bones named 'render' cannot be referenced by animations
This setting when enabled will log errors for any animations that violate these rules and invalidate them.

entity_model_features.entity_model_features.config.optifine_su:
In OptiFine the subfolder option for model files only works if that model variates.
E.G. 'optifine/cem/skeleton/skeleton.jem' will only load if it has variants
such as 'optifine/cem/skeleton/skeleton2.jem' or a .properties file

Model variables are specified in the format
 "<model>.<variable_name>"

The model can be:
 "this" - current custom model
 "part" - the original part model to which the custom model is attached
 "<part>" - original model by part name
 "<id>" - custom model by ID
 "<part>:<sub_id>:<sub_sub_id>:..." - (hierarchical) start with original model by part name, then find children by ID
 "<id>:<sub_id>:<sub_sub_id>:..." - (hierarchical) start with model by ID, then find children by ID

The first model found by part name or ID is used if there are duplicates.
The model search by ID is deep, also when used in a hierarchical specification. 

The hierarchical specification allows model groups (json part models) to be reused for different parts. 
For example one hand model ("shoulder:upper_arm:elbow:forearm:palm:finger[1.5]" can be used for both left and right hand.
The animation can use "left_hand:finger1" for the left thumb and "right_hand:finger1" for the right thumb. 
The intermediate parents in the hierarchical specification can be skipped.
